action_lifecycle_observed.propose: Agent chat reply carries bracket-grammar tags [ACTION:TYPE|key:value|...]; routes.ts regex-extracts them, strips them from the visible reply, and inserts an agent_actions row (status=pending, requiresApproval=true) attributed to agent+user+conversation, with an estimatedTimeSaved heuristic (5 min email / 3 min other).
action_lifecycle_observed.approve: POST /api/actions/:id/approve — ownership check (action.userId == session user), sets status=approved + approvedBy/approvedAt, then IMMEDIATELY executes inline in the same request cycle. POST /api/actions/:id/reject sets status=rejected.
action_lifecycle_observed.execute: action-executor.ts executeAction(): status=executing + executedAt, then a switch on actionType — send_email (Gmail adapter over stored OAuth token), create_task (tasks insert), create_document (documents insert). Unknown types throw.
action_lifecycle_observed.record: Success: status=completed, completedAt, executionResult jsonb. Failure: failedAt, errorMessage, retryCount+1.
action_lifecycle_observed.retry: On failure with retryCount < maxRetries (default 3): status returns to 'pending' — the action re-enters the human approval queue, so every retry is human-re-approved. At maxRetries: status=failed terminally.
action_lifecycle_observed.learn: On success: incrementMetric(actionsExecuted) and incrementMetric(estimatedTimeSavedMinutes) into per-agent per-day agent_metrics rows.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Turn agent free-text output into a structured, pending, approval-gated action intent; never execute from raw model output.
seams.target_owner: transports/api/governed.py (governed_mutation MutationRequest construction); the bracket grammar itself stays EOS L3 prompt protocol in projections/eos
seams.notes: Deterministic regex parsing = deterministic spine. The grammar string format is projection vocabulary, not substrate.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Durable record of a proposed action awaiting human decision: who proposed, for whom, what, with what parameters, current lifecycle state.
seams.notes: EOS row lacks risk_class — every action carries equal approval weight. UMH adds deterministic risk classification (ActionRiskClass) on import. Any persistent store change is schema territory: owner approval.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Human decision transition with ownership authorization; approval is the only path to execution.
seams.target_owner: substrate/control_plane (authority engine approval gates) via the canonical governed spine; ApprovalState PENDING→APPROVED/REJECTED
seams.notes: EOS executes inline in the approve request cycle; UMH decouples decision from execution through the spine (approve → queued operation), which also fixes the HTTP-timeout blast radius.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Execute exactly one approved action with lifecycle stamping (executing→completed/failed); unknown action types fail closed.
seams.target_owner: substrate/organism/canonical_runtime.py — governed_mutation → MutationRouter → GovernedExecutionSpine (the EOS executor is a hand-rolled instance of this exact path)
seams.notes: NEVER a parallel executor in UMH — the canonical runtime is the one choke point.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Map an approved action type to the concrete capability that performs it.
seams.target_owner: substrate/execution/runtime/capability_router.py (Capability enum, 28 job capabilities) + CapabilityInvocation in substrate/types.py
seams.universal_or_eos_specific: universal mechanism; the three EOS action types are L3 entries in a capability registry
seams.notes: EOS's three types are seed entries; expansion follows P2 capability contracts, not new switch arms.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Perform the real-world side effect (send email) with credential acquisition, token refresh, and provider error propagation.
seams.target_owner: adapters/ (existing GWS adapters) with AdapterRequest/AdapterResponse from substrate/types.py; credentials through substrate/execution/credential_gate.py (1Password op run)
seams.notes: SECURITY FLAG: EOS stores accessToken/refreshToken PLAINTEXT in the oauth_tokens table. Importing this seam requires migrating credential storage to the 1Password credential-injection law — owner approval before any credential migration.

seams.beast_source: action-executor.ts + agent_actions columns (executionResult jsonb, errorMessage, executedAt/completedAt/failedAt)
seams.semantic_responsibility: Durable, queryable evidence of what an executed action actually did or why it failed.
seams.notes: EOS records result-on-row; UMH separates Proof (evidence) from Trace (execution timeline) — both fed from the spine.

seams.beast_source: action-executor.ts failure branch (retryCount/maxRetries, status back to 'pending')
seams.semantic_responsibility: Failed actions re-enter the approval queue (every retry is human-re-approved), bounded at maxRetries=3, then terminal failure.
seams.target_owner: GovernedExecutionSpine retry policy + approval re-queue through the authority engine
seams.universal_or_eos_specific: universal — and a semantics worth PRESERVING: retry-requires-re-approval is stricter than auto-retry and matches UMH fail-closed philosophy
seams.notes: Do not 'improve' this into silent auto-retry for side-effecting actions.

seams.beast_source: storage.incrementMetric() into agent_metrics (actionsExecuted, estimatedTimeSavedMinutes, per agent per day)
seams.semantic_responsibility: Per-actor per-day outcome counters feeding value accounting (time saved) and activity scoring.
seams.target_owner: substrate/execution/feedback.py (quality scoring + learning loop) + work_portfolio velocity records
seams.universal_or_eos_specific: universal mechanism; estimatedTimeSaved heuristics (5/3 min) are EOS L3 values
seams.notes: read-modify-write increment is racy in EOS; UMH feedback loop is the canonical accumulator.

seams.semantic_responsibility: An approved action can mint new units of work attributed to an agent.
seams.target_owner: substrate/types.py WorkPacket + universal_work stores; creation through governed_mutation
seams.notes: EOS task fields (status/priority vocab) are L3; WorkPacket is the substrate shape.

seams.semantic_responsibility: An approved action can produce a persistent document artifact owned by the user.
seams.target_owner: projections/eos (EOS L3 domain mutation) wrapped in governed_mutation when built; document store remains projection-owned
seams.universal_or_eos_specific: eos_specific domain effect through a universal governed write
seams.notes: Touches the EOS Neon DB — any real write path is schema/data territory.

seams.semantic_responsibility: Filterable read view of the action queue (by status/agent) for the approval UI.

seams.notes: Read-only; conforms to the read-surface discipline established by /eos/activation.

recommended_first_slice.name: EOS ActionProposal read seam
recommended_first_slice.shape: A projection-owned, read-only accessor (projections/eos) translating an EOS agent_actions row shape into a substrate ApprovalRequest view, exposed through one discipline-conformant /eos/actions read surface. No writes, no schema, no executor.
recommended_first_slice.why: Smallest seam that exercises the Approval primitive mapping end-to-end against real EOS data, conforms to the read-surface discipline (like /eos/activation), and gives the cockpit a real approval-queue view before any execution wiring.
recommended_first_slice.explicitly_not: No approve/reject write path, no executor port, no capability routing — those follow once the read seam is proven.
